correctness.rationale: The complete face poset of \(M_2(K_{3,4})\) has 1081 faces including the empty face. The explicit sequential edge-toggle matching has 539 pairs and exactly one critical 0-cell and one critical 5-cell. A direct topological-sort check of the Morse-oriented graph on all 4488 nonempty Hasse covers proves acyclicity. Forman discrete Morse theory then gives \(M_2(K_{3,4})\simeq S^5\). Two independent mod-2 boundary-rank eliminations give ranks \(11,55,149,211,113\) and Betti vector \(1,0,0,0,0,1\), corroborating the proof.

value.rationale: The parameter \(M_2(K_{3,4})\) is mathematically motivated: it is the smallest unequal complete-bipartite two-matching complex with both bipartition sizes larger than the matching bound, immediately beyond Singh's shellable region and the balanced \(K_{3,3}\) boundary case. The exact sphere result therefore supplies a natural boundary datum for the unresolved complete-bipartite regime. The claim is stronger than a Betti-number recomputation because the explicit acyclic Morse matching determines homotopy type and provides a concrete template for larger \(K_{3,n}\) investigations.
